title: SunPath Solar Lease System Size Schedule
content:
Calloway Energy Services leases each SunPath Solar Lease system in one of six sizes. The size is the tier of the lease, and the size of a home's system is fixed by the conditioned floor area of the home's plan. This schedule gives, for every size, the equipment and production figures of the system.

## Terms used in the schedule

- **System size** — the nameplate DC system size, in kilowatts.
- **Panels** — the number of 400-watt panels in the system.
- **Conditioned floor area band** — the smallest and the largest conditioned floor area, in square feet, of a home sized to that system; both ends of the band belong to it.
- **Estimated first-year production** — the estimated production of the system in its first lease year, in kWh.
- **Home battery** — whether a home battery is included, and its usable capacity in kWh (0 where none is included).
- **Monitoring** — whether production monitoring is included.
- **Export tariff** — the utility export tariff the system is interconnected under.

## Schedule

| Tier | System size (kW) | Panels | Conditioned floor area band (sq ft) | Estimated first-year production (kWh) | Home battery | Usable battery capacity (kWh) | Monitoring | Export tariff |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| SunPath 3.2 kW | 3.2 | 8 | 1200 to 1699 | 5120 | Not included | 0 | Included | Net billing tariff |
| SunPath 4.0 kW | 4.0 | 10 | 1700 to 2199 | 6400 | Not included | 0 | Included | Net billing tariff |
| SunPath 4.8 kW | 4.8 | 12 | 2200 to 2699 | 7680 | Not included | 0 | Included | Net billing tariff |
| SunPath 5.6 kW | 5.6 | 14 | 2700 to 3199 | 8960 | Not included | 0 | Included | Net billing tariff |
| SunPath 6.4 kW | 6.4 | 16 | 3200 to 3899 | 10240 | Included | 13.5 | Included | Net billing tariff |
| SunPath 8.0 kW | 8.0 | 20 | 3900 to 5500 | 12800 | Included | 13.5 | Included | Net billing tariff |

## Reading the bands

The bands run end to end without a gap from 1200 to 5500 square feet. Each band's last square foot is followed directly by the next band's first, so a plan that sits on a band edge belongs to exactly one size:

| Hypothetical plan area (sq ft) | Size whose band contains it |
|---|---|
| 1699 | SunPath 3.2 kW |
| 1700 | SunPath 4.0 kW |
| 2699 | SunPath 4.8 kW |
| 2700 | SunPath 5.6 kW |
| 3899 | SunPath 6.4 kW |
| 3900 | SunPath 8.0 kW |

## Points of reference

- Only the SunPath 6.4 kW and SunPath 8.0 kW systems include a home battery, each with 13.5 kWh of usable capacity.
- Every size includes production monitoring and is interconnected under the net billing tariff.
- The panel count multiplied by 400 watts gives the nameplate size: for example, 16 panels of 400 watts make 6400 watts, the 6.4 kW system.
